daily.today_energy: Your emotional radar is finely tuned today. Trust those gut feelings—they're basically your superpower right now. Something's shifting beneath the surface, and you're picking up on it before anyone else.
daily.love: If you're coupled up, your partner might need a little extra reassurance today. If you're solo, someone's noticing your energy. Either way, vulnerability is your love language rn—lean into it.
daily.career: Your creativity is flowing, but don't overthink the execution. Pitch that idea you've been sitting on. Your vibe is magnetic enough to convince people today, so let your passion do the talking.
daily.health: Your body's asking for gentleness today. Maybe skip the intense workout and opt for something grounding instead—yoga, a walk, journaling. Your nervous system will thank you for the soft reset.

weekly.overview: This week's cosmic energy is asking you to soften your edges, Cancer. You're carrying old patterns like luggage—it's time to set some down. Trust that vulnerability isn't weakness; it's your superpower.
weekly.love: Someone's seeing you differently lately, and honestly, they might be onto something. If you're single, a genuine conversation is brewing. If coupled, reconnect over something that made you laugh together.
weekly.career: Your ideas have more weight than you think right now. Speak up in that meeting or share your vision with someone who matters. The energy supports bold honesty over playing it safe.
